title: Exception FAQ (IN) [SOFT_FLAG] — Can I extend a business trip for personal leisure (bleisure) over the weekend?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: Can I extend a business trip for personal leisure (bleisure) over the weekend? Answer: Yes, provided the return flight costs equal to or less than a standard business-only itinerary (comparison screenshot mandatory). All hotel, meal, and transport expenses during personal days are strictly non-reimbursable. Missing fare-comparison evidence triggers NEEDS_INFORMATION; higher airfare without paying the difference triggers a SOFT_FLAG.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [SOFT_FLAG] — Is alcohol reimbursable during a client dinner?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: Is alcohol reimbursable during a client dinner? Answer: Alcohol is strictly prohibited for solo or internal team meals (HARD_FLAG). During external client dinners, moderate alcohol (max 2 drinks per attendee, within the per-attendee client entertainment cap) is allowed only with itemized receipt, attendee list, and Department Head review (SOFT_FLAG).

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [SOFT_FLAG] — What if every hotel in my destination city exceeds the nightly cap due to a major conference?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: What if every hotel in my destination city exceeds the nightly cap due to a major conference? Answer: If a citywide event causes all corporate-portal hotels to exceed the city-tier cap by more than 15%, attach a portal search screenshot showing no compliant rooms within 5 km. This converts a standard HARD_FLAG into a SOFT_FLAG routed to Department Head + Finance review.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [SOFT_FLAG] — My client scheduled an emergency meeting 3 days before travel, violating the advance booking window.
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: My client scheduled an emergency meeting 3 days before travel, violating the advance booking window. Answer: Bookings made inside the grade-based advance booking window trigger a SOFT_FLAG (not a HARD_FLAG). Attach the client email or incident ticket as justification for Direct Manager approval.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [HARD_FLAG] — Can I split a single meal or vendor bill into two smaller claims below the receipt threshold?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: HARD_FLAG. Question: Can I split a single meal or vendor bill into two smaller claims below the receipt threshold? Answer: No. Deliberately splitting expenses to bypass receipt thresholds or approval slabs is a policy violation classified as HARD_FLAG and escalated to Finance Audit.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [NEEDS_INFORMATION] — What happens if I submit a travel request with an expired or missing project code?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: NEEDS_INFORMATION. Question: What happens if I submit a travel request with an expired or missing project code? Answer: The system cannot validate budget ownership without an active project code. Requests with missing or closed project codes must be classified as NEEDS_INFORMATION until the employee provides an active code.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — I have a documented medical condition and need Business Class on a domestic flight as an L3 employee.
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: I have a documented medical condition and need Business Class on a domestic flight as an L3 employee. Answer: Medical accommodation cabin upgrades are not auto-approved or auto-rejected by standard rules. Classify as HUMAN_REVIEW and escalate to HR Benefits and the Finance Policy Desk with medical documentation.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [HARD_FLAG] — Can I expense my spouse's flight or hotel room upgrade on a 2-week work trip?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: HARD_FLAG. Question: Can I expense my spouse's flight or hotel room upgrade on a 2-week work trip? Answer: Companion travel expenses and room upgrades for family members are prohibited across all grades (HARD_FLAG). Only the single-occupancy base room rate is reimbursable.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [SOFT_FLAG] — I lost my itemized hotel folio and only have my credit card statement.
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: I lost my itemized hotel folio and only have my credit card statement. Answer: A credit card statement alone is insufficient because hotels may include prohibited items (minibar, movies, spa). Request a duplicate folio from the hotel; if impossible, submit a Lost Receipt Affidavit (SOFT_FLAG, max 2/year).

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — My corporate card FX rate differs by 6% from the standard monthly reimbursement rate.
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: My corporate card FX rate differs by 6% from the standard monthly reimbursement rate. Answer: FX variances up to 3% are auto-accepted with card statement proof (PASS). Variances above 5% without card-issuer documentation require Finance Policy Desk verification (HUMAN_REVIEW).

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [PASS] — Can I claim mileage from my home to the airport for a business trip?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: PASS. Question: Can I claim mileage from my home to the airport for a business trip? Answer: Yes. Travel from home to the airport or railway station for an approved business trip is reimbursable at the regional per-km/mile rate, minus normal daily commute distance if departing during regular office hours.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [HARD_FLAG] — Can I claim both the per-km EV mileage rate and public EV charging receipts?
text: Region: IN | Expected Classification: HARD_FLAG. Question: Can I claim both the per-km EV mileage rate and public EV charging receipts? Answer: No. The official EV mileage reimbursement rate already covers electricity, wear-and-tear, and insurance. Claiming both mileage and fuel/charging receipts is double-dipping and triggers a HARD_FLAG.

title: Exception FAQ (IN) [SOFT_FLAG] — My conference registration included lunch, can I still claim full daily per diem?

Unadjusted claims trigger a SOFT_FLAG.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — I have a documented medical condition and need Business Class on a domestic flight as an L3 employee.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: I have a documented medical condition and need Business Class on a domestic flight as an L3 employee. Answer: Medical accommodation cabin upgrades are not auto-approved or auto-rejected by standard rules. Classify as HUMAN_REVIEW and escalate to HR Benefits and the Finance Policy Desk with medical documentation.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HARD_FLAG] — Can I expense my spouse's flight or hotel room upgrade on a 2-week work trip?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HARD_FLAG. Question: Can I expense my spouse's flight or hotel room upgrade on a 2-week work trip? Answer: Companion travel expenses and room upgrades for family members are prohibited across all grades (HARD_FLAG). Only the single-occupancy base room rate is reimbursable.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — I lost my itemized hotel folio and only have my credit card statement.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: I lost my itemized hotel folio and only have my credit card statement. Answer: A credit card statement alone is insufficient because hotels may include prohibited items (minibar, movies, spa). Request a duplicate folio from the hotel; if impossible, submit a Lost Receipt Affidavit (SOFT_FLAG, max 2/year).

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — My corporate card FX rate differs by 6% from the standard monthly reimbursement rate.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: My corporate card FX rate differs by 6% from the standard monthly reimbursement rate. Answer: FX variances up to 3% are auto-accepted with card statement proof (PASS). Variances above 5% without card-issuer documentation require Finance Policy Desk verification (HUMAN_REVIEW).

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [PASS] — Can I claim mileage from my home to the airport for a business trip?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: PASS. Question: Can I claim mileage from my home to the airport for a business trip? Answer: Yes. Travel from home to the airport or railway station for an approved business trip is reimbursable at the regional per-km/mile rate, minus normal daily commute distance if departing during regular office hours.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HARD_FLAG] — Can I claim both the per-km EV mileage rate and public EV charging receipts?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HARD_FLAG. Question: Can I claim both the per-km EV mileage rate and public EV charging receipts? Answer: No. The official EV mileage reimbursement rate already covers electricity, wear-and-tear, and insurance. Claiming both mileage and fuel/charging receipts is double-dipping and triggers a HARD_FLAG.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — My conference registration included lunch, can I still claim full daily per diem?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: My conference registration included lunch, can I still claim full daily per diem? Answer: No. Full per diem cannot be claimed when meals are provided by the hotel, airline, or conference. Deduct 20% for breakfast, 30% for lunch, and 50% for dinner. Unadjusted claims trigger a SOFT_FLAG.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [PASS] — I booked a non-preferred hotel that is 25% cheaper than the corporate preferred chain.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: PASS. Question: I booked a non-preferred hotel that is 25% cheaper than the corporate preferred chain. Answer: Compliant (PASS), provided the property meets corporate safety standards, falls within the city-tier cap, and an itemized tax invoice is submitted.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — Are external contractors eligible for standard employee per diem rates?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: Are external contractors eligible for standard employee per diem rates? Answer: Contractor travel reimbursement depends on the Statement of Work (SOW), not employee policy. Classify as HUMAN_REVIEW and route to Procurement / Finance Policy Desk.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [PASS] — Can I upgrade my Economy ticket to Business Class using my personal frequent flyer miles?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: PASS. Question: Can I upgrade my Economy ticket to Business Class using my personal frequent flyer miles? Answer: Yes (PASS), provided the company is only billed for the policy-compliant base fare and no extra change/upgrade fees are expensed.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — Heavy rain caused Uber surge pricing that pushed my daily ground transport 18% over the cap.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: Heavy rain caused Uber surge pricing that pushed my daily ground transport 18% over the cap. Answer: Ground transport overages up to 20% due to surge pricing or airport congestion trigger a SOFT_FLAG with trip receipt and brief note for Direct Manager approval. Overages above 20% require Department Head review.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — Can I expense expedited visa processing fees for an urgent client visit?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: Can I expense expedited visa processing fees for an urgent client visit? Answer: Standard visa fees are reimbursable (PASS). Expedited processing fees exceeding the regional visa cap by up to 10% trigger a SOFT_FLAG requiring confirmation that travel urgency was business-driven.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — Can I expense a day pass at a coworking space during a remote client trip?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: Can I expense a day pass at a coworking space during a remote client trip? Answer: Coworking passes are not explicitly covered under standard hotel or telecom categories. Classify as HUMAN_REVIEW for Finance Policy Desk determination unless pre-approved in the project budget.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [NEEDS_INFORMATION] — What if a user asks whether a INR 14,000 hotel in Mumbai is compliant without giving travel dates or grade?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: NEEDS_INFORMATION. Question: What if a user asks whether a INR 14,000 hotel in Mumbai is compliant without giving travel dates or grade? Answer: Nightly caps depend on both employee grade band and peak/off-peak travel dates. The agent must never assume grade or dates and must return NEEDS_INFORMATION requesting both fields.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — Staying over Saturday night reduces my airfare by USD 600, more than the extra hotel night.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: Staying over Saturday night reduces my airfare by USD 600, more than the extra hotel night. Answer: Permitted as a cost-saving exception (SOFT_FLAG) if total trip cost (flight + extra hotel + per diem) is lower than returning Friday. Attach fare comparison for Direct Manager sign-off.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [PASS] — How are small cash tips for hotel porters or cab drivers handled without receipts?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: PASS. Question: How are small cash tips for hotel porters or cab drivers handled without receipts? Answer: Reasonable cash gratuities below the regional receipt threshold are reimbursable within the daily incidental per diem without a receipt (PASS), provided they are itemized in the claim description.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — My international flight lands at 5 AM; can I book an extra half-day early check-in?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: My international flight lands at 5 AM; can I book an extra half-day early check-in? Answer: Early check-in fees up to 50% of the nightly cap are permitted after overnight flights exceeding 6 hours, routed as SOFT_FLAG with boarding pass proof.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [PASS] — A client rescheduled our meeting and the airline charged a cancellation/rebooking fee.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: PASS. Question: A client rescheduled our meeting and the airline charged a cancellation/rebooking fee. Answer: Business-driven cancellation or rebooking fees are reimbursable (PASS) with the original ticket, new itinerary, and client rescheduling email attached.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — I used my personal credit card instead of the corporate card for a hotel booking.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: I used my personal credit card instead of the corporate card for a hotel booking. Answer: Employees issued a corporate card must use it for all flight and hotel bookings. Using a personal card for points accumulation triggers a SOFT_FLAG on the first occurrence and Finance escalation if repeated.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — I paid for a dinner for 5 internal team members during an offsite.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: I paid for a dinner for 5 internal team members during an offsite. Answer: Internal team meals must be billed under the most senior employee's corporate card and stay within the regional daily meal cap per attendee. Submitting an internal meal as 'client entertainment' is a HARD_FLAG; overages up to 15% trigger a SOFT_FLAG.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — My Indian hotel invoice does not include the company's GSTIN.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: My Indian hotel invoice does not include the company's GSTIN. Answer: For Indian domestic hotel stays, employees must provide the company's state GSTIN at check-in so input tax credit can be claimed. Invoices missing GSTIN above INR 5,000 trigger a SOFT_FLAG and Finance tax review.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [SOFT_FLAG] — Can I expense a one-time airport lounge pass during a 6-hour international layover?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: SOFT_FLAG. Question: Can I expense a one-time airport lounge pass during a 6-hour international layover? Answer: Personal airline lounge memberships are strictly prohibited (HARD_FLAG). However, a single-use lounge pass for involuntary layovers exceeding 4 hours may be reviewed as a SOFT_FLAG with boarding pass proof.

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HARD_FLAG] — Can I claim daily meal per diem AND submit individual restaurant receipts on the same day?
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HARD_FLAG. Question: Can I claim daily meal per diem AND submit individual restaurant receipts on the same day? Answer: No. Mixing per diem and actual meal receipts on the same travel day is double reimbursement and triggers a HARD_FLAG. Use per diem for personal meals and actuals only for documented client entertainment (with meal deduction).

title: Exception FAQ (APAC) [HUMAN_REVIEW] — A foreign vendor only accepted stablecoin/crypto payment for a conference booth.
text: Region: APAC | Expected Classification: HUMAN_REVIEW. Question: A foreign vendor only accepted stablecoin/crypto payment for a conference booth. Answer: Non-fiat/cryptocurrency reimbursements fall outside standard T&E rails. Classify as HUMAN_REVIEW and escalate to Treasury and the Finance Policy Desk.
